pages.title: Pattern-weavers
pages.text:
The Pattern-weavers sang factories the way you would sing a round: one figure, then the same figure again, until the work carried itself.

Their timed lattice songs are the ancestor of every belt and cog you will build. You already know this craft.

pages.title: Clock Strand
pages.text:
*A factory is a song that has stopped needing the singer.*

Seated. The Pattern-weavers answer when this Post hums.
